Opt in to OCR elements to get each word's text, bounding box and confidence

```rust title="Rust"
use xberg::extract;
use xberg::ExtractInput;

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() {
    let input_json: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(r#"{"kind":"uri","mime_type":"image/png","uri":"https://example.com/images/test_hello_world.png"}"#).unwrap();
    let input = serde_json::from_value::<ExtractInput>(input_json).unwrap();
    let config_json: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(r#"{"force_ocr":true,"ocr":{"backend":"tesseract","element_config":{"include_elements":true,"min_level":"word"},"enabled":true,"language":["eng"]}}"#).unwrap();
    let config = serde_json::from_value(config_json).unwrap();
    let result = extract(input, &config).await.expect("call failed");
    println!("{:?}", result.results[0].ocr_elements);
}
```
